description: Fork of exp275 (dual-stream E=64, d_v=24 -> 1.6904 @ 8K). Major recipe change: (1) v_lut soft NAP=6 (was multi-alt NAP=8); (2) out_proj flat tph=2048 across all 6 layers (was [2048,2048,1024,1024,1024,1024]); (3) NEW ffn_lut after out_proj, soft NAP=6 tph=256, E->E; (4) residual_lut switched to soft NAP=6 tph=256 (was multi-alt NAP=8 tph=256), takes ffn_lut output. Single ln_block_end at end of block, after ffn_lut, feeds both next-block and residual_lut. Estimated ~199M params. Comparator: exp275=1.6904 (same E=64 base).
